scripts.test: nbb --classpath src:test -e "(require '[clojure.test :as t] 'slack.main-test) (set! (.-exitCode js/process) 1) (defmethod t/report [:cljs.test/default :end-run-tests] [m] (set! (.-exitCode js/process) (cond (zero? (+ (:pass m) (:fail m) (:error m))) 2 (t/successful? m) 0 :else 1))) (t/run-tests 'slack.main-test)"
